plugins.name: timesheet
plugins.description: Rebuilds worked hours from git history and Claude Code sessions, and adds them as blocks to a private Google Calendar that Productive reads as timesheet suggestions. Daily macOS reminder.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Writes your standup, end-of-day note, weekly recap or client summary from your commits, PRs and Claude conversations. Asks before posting to Slack.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Gets a branch ready for review: reverts leftover TEMP changes, flags new TODOs, reviews the diff, lists what's needed before release, and writes the PR description in your voice.

plugins.name: ticket
plugins.description: Turns a ticket and its Figma links into an agreed implementation plan before any code: requirements, open questions, codebase map, a message for the PO, and a branch or worktree.

plugins.name: design-qa
plugins.description: Checks a page or component against its Figma design with measured properties and a pixel diff, across states and breakpoints, and says which file to fix.

plugins.name: temp-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Claude's commits, pushes and PRs while temporary changes marked TEMP are in, and warns about new TODO/FIXME comments.

plugins.name: dcepa95
plugins.description: Installs the timesheet plugin. Kept so existing installs keep working; install the other plugins one by one.
